<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 1000">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="1000" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <text x="100" y="65" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="27">
    Steady two-dimensional heat conduction
  </text>
  <text x="100" y="105" fill="#364152" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="21">
    ∂²T/∂x² + ∂²T/∂y² = 0
  </text>

  <g data-field="T" data-status="ill-posed">
    <rect x="100" y="140" width="800" height="175" rx="6"
          fill="#fff8ed" stroke="#a45b12" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="120" y="173" fill="#82430b" font-family="sans-serif"
          font-size="20" font-weight="bold">
      Exact endpoint conditions are incompatible
    </text>
    <text x="120" y="206" fill="#493524" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18">
      Each lower corner belongs to both a 100°C edge and a 0°C edge.
    </text>
    <text x="120" y="237" fill="#493524" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18">
      No contours can satisfy both prescriptions at those vertices.
    </text>
    <text x="120" y="278" fill="#493524" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18">
      Requested isotherms: 10, 20, 40, 60, 80°C — not drawn as exact.
    </text>
  </g>

  <text x="100" y="350" fill="#364152" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17">
    Usual solvable interpretation: prescribe temperatures on open edges,
  </text>
  <text x="100" y="377" fill="#364152" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17">
    allowing temperature jumps at the two lower corners.
  </text>

  <!-- Plate: X = 100 + 800x; Y = 900 - 800y. -->
  <rect x="100" y="420" width="800" height="480"
        fill="#f7f9fc" stroke="#17212b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M100 900 V420 H900 V900"
        fill="none" stroke="#2466a0" stroke-width="4"/>
  <path d="M100 900 H900"
        fill="none" stroke="#bc392c" stroke-width="4"/>

  <text x="500" y="409" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#2466a0" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">
    y = 0.6 · T = 0°C
  </text>
  <text x="128" y="650" fill="#2466a0"
        font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">T = 0°C</text>
  <text x="872" y="650" text-anchor="end" fill="#2466a0"
        font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">T = 0°C</text>
  <text x="500" y="884" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#bc392c" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">
    y = 0 · T = 100°C
  </text>

  <text x="500" y="660" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#596575" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22">
    Rectilinear plate
  </text>
  <text x="500" y="693" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#596575" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18">
    0 < x < 1, 0 < y < 0.6
  </text>

  <!-- Dimension lines. -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#596575" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="100" y1="925" x2="100" y2="967"/>
    <line x1="900" y1="925" x2="900" y2="967"/>
    <line x1="100" y1="953" x2="900" y2="953"/>
    <path d="M94 959 L106 947 M894 959 L906 947"/>
    <line x1="62" y1="420" x2="88" y2="420"/>
    <line x1="62" y1="900" x2="88" y2="900"/>
    <line x1="72" y1="420" x2="72" y2="900"/>
    <path d="M66 426 L78 414 M66 906 L78 894"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="466" y="939" width="68" height="28" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <text x="500" y="960" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#364152" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">1.0</text>
  <text x="49" y="660" text-anchor="middle"
        transform="rotate(-90 49 660)"
        fill="#364152" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">0.6</text>

  <!-- Highlight the contradictory endpoint prescriptions. -->
  <circle cx="100" cy="900" r="9" fill="#fff8ed" stroke="#a45b12" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="900" cy="900" r="9" fill="#fff8ed" stroke="#a45b12" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M107 893 L151 819 H289 M893 893 L849 819 H711"
        fill="none" stroke="#a45b12" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="157" y="807" fill="#82430b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17">
    0°C and 100°C
  </text>
  <text x="843" y="807" text-anchor="end"
        fill="#82430b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17">
    0°C and 100°C
  </text>

  <text x="100" y="932" fill="#364152"
        font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16">(0, 0)</text>
  <text x="900" y="932" text-anchor="end" fill="#364152"
        font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16">(1, 0)</text>
  <text x="113" y="445" fill="#364152"
        font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16">(0, 0.6)</text>
  <text x="887" y="445" text-anchor="end" fill="#364152"
        font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16">(1, 0.6)</text>
</svg>
